question: Deepika Pallikal is assoicated with ___________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __Squash__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Deepika Pallikal is related to Squash.

 
 
• Dipika Pallikal Karthik (born 21 September 1991) is an Indian professional squash player.
 
• She is the first Indian to break into the top 10 in the Professional Squash Association Women's rankings.
 
• Dipika Pallikal came to prominence in 2011, when she won three WISPA tour titles to attain a career-best ranking of 13th. 
 
• Dipika started her career in a promising fashion.
 
• She reached the final of the Chennai Open in 2008, beating the first and third seeds on her way.
 
• This phenomenal player is known to play a prominent role in making Squash popular among the Indian masses.
